Choose one small personal learning goal

Request meaning, example, repetition or help when blocked

Review previously encountered material periodically
Compare an answer with a model and repair it
Record perceived difficulty/progress after a task
PCIC-13 is a single ungraded list; no item is A1 by position alone.
A procedure becomes strategic only when consciously selected/evaluated for a goal.
The inventory is not a fixed recipe or mandatory sequence.
Procedure usefulness depends on task, learner and context.
Learning autonomy is not a lexical/grammar proficiency score.
Anxiety, self-concept or motivation are not CEFR pass/fail variables.
Cooperation quality is not evidence of A1 linguistic mastery.
Dictionary/translator/technology examples do not create A1 vocabulary assertions.
Periodic review in PCIC does not prescribe a specific spaced-repetition algorithm.
Learning-strategy events belong to a learning/autonomy layer, not the Lexical Engine core taxonomy.
